truth_boundary: Potential resident-object set cardinality from R13 stream-cell membership. Not RAM, VRAM, draw calls, shader cost, IO latency, residency latency or performance measurement.
hero_overlay_observations: A hero residency group must be contextual, not globally always-on. Adding a distant hero group can raise resident sets substantially (e.g. Puerto start + VESPER overlay reached 130 objects in the study).
At Bosque/X2Y2 the Bosque and VESPER core cells are already contained by current+8; extra hero cells add nothing there, while an unrelated Puerto overlay would add 28 objects.
Directional route-window cardinality is lower than current+8 but still reaches 86 objects because large roots/routes legitimately cross multiple cells.

proposal.fallback_safety_ring: ENGINE/runtime team may add neighbor cells based on measured IO/residency latency; do not hardcode without test evidence
proposal.reason: Current+8 loads up to 72.8% of current spatial objects by membership cardinality. Directional window lowers potential resident set while preserving route continuity, but async loading/performance has not been measured.

next_gate: Import exact R13 artifact into qualified runtime.
Instrument cell enter/leave and object residency.
Traverse the real 8.9 km route at player and future vehicle speeds.
Compare current+8, current+4 and directional route-window for pop-in, load stalls, memory and draw cost.
Trigger only the relevant approaching/current hero residency group; measure prefetch lead time.
Promote a policy only after runtime + hardware receipts.
